LinkedCall_1: Walks a command list at a2 and loads tile data for each entry (uses the $FF12B0 helper).
LinkedCall_2: Interrupts off, VDP busy flag set, then loads d1 blocks from a0.
LinkedCall_3: Expands tile data from a3 into 32-byte tiles at a1 (d3 selects the format).
LinkedCall_4: CopyToVdp with the VDP busy flag set.
LinkedCall_5: Copies d0 words from a0 to the VDP data port; splits the copy at a 64 KB boundary.
LinkedCall_6: Spins until the VDP status DMA-busy bit clears.
LinkedCall_7: Sets the VDP VRAM write address from d0 (returns the data port in a0).
LinkedCall_8: Turns the current plane cursor into a nametable address.
LinkedCall_9: Fills a tilemap rectangle with the tile in d2.
LinkedCall_10: Enables interrupts and waits for the vertical blank counter.
LinkedCall_11: Clears both plane nametables in VRAM.
LinkedCall_12: Prints a glyph string into the tilemap at the cursor.
LinkedCall_13: Prints one glyph and advances the cursor.
LinkedCall_18: Prints a counted string with the plane parameters at $FF287A.
DispatchTail_1: Draws a list of line segments held at a1.
DispatchTail_2: VdpSetWriteAddr taking the address in d1 and keeping a1.
DispatchTail_3: Packs the glyph bitmap at a0 into 4-bit pixels at $FF2916.
DispatchTail_4: Reads both control pads (or the CD-side pad state) into $FF284A/$FF284B.
DispatchTail_7: Waits for and takes word RAM for the main CPU.
DispatchTail_8: Gives word RAM back to the sub CPU if it was taken.
DispatchTail_24: C function: draws text to the plane at $E000 (args on the stack).
DispatchTail_25: C function: draws a string buffer, waiting for the VDP command queue.
DispatchTail_60: Waits for a command word from the sub CPU ($A12020) (Sierra tag GetCommandFromSub).
DispatchTail_61: Writes the word-RAM 1M flag word to the sub CPU comm port (Sierra tag Set1MFlag).
DispatchTailSub2: Handshakes with the sub CPU on $A1200E/F and reads the comm word $A12020.
DispatchTail_65: Two-phase flag handshake with the sub CPU.
DispatchTail_66: Spins while the word-RAM mode bit is 1M.
DispatchTailSub5: Spins while the word-RAM DMNA bit is set.
DispatchTail_67: Sets DMNA and waits until the sub CPU has taken word RAM.
DispatchTailSub6: Sets the VDP command for a VRAM write at d0.
DispatchTailSub8: Sets the VDP command for a CRAM write at d0.
DispatchTailSub9: Writes zeros over all 64 KB of VRAM.
DispatchTailSub10: Reads both pads into $FF4F84/$FF4F85 and updates the edge state.
DispatchTailSub11: Decodes pad 1 and computes the newly pressed buttons.
DispatchTailSub12: Decodes pad 2 and computes the newly pressed buttons.
DispatchTail_68: Inverts the raw pad byte and splits it into direction and button bits.
Set1MFlag_26: Requests the Z80 bus and waits for it.
Set1MFlag_28: Prepares reading from sub-CPU PRG RAM when the address is at or above $80000.
Set1MFlag_29: Waits until the PRG-RAM read window is ready.
Set1MFlag_30: Maps a0 into the PRG-RAM window address.
Set1MFlag_12: Reads the Z80 driver status byte at $A00024.
Set1MFlag_13: Looks up d0 in the loaded-sound bitmap and starts it or queues a load.
Set1MFlag_14: Appends command d0 to the Z80 driver command queue.
Set1MFlag_15: Loads the pending sound blocks into the Z80 driver.
Set1MFlagSub5: Copies a sound block into Z80 RAM, checking the free space.
Set1MFlag_16: Marks all 32 sound slots as empty.
Set1MFlag_17: Looks for the sound slot whose id matches d0.
Set1MFlag_18: Stores d0 in the next free sound slot.
Set1MFlag_20: Starts a sound stream from the table at $A00072.
Set1MFlag_21: Finds the sound source for the request in d0/d1 in the list at 4 sources.
LinkedCall: Clears the tile-load pointer, then runs ProcessTileCmdList.
DispatchPrep: Raises main-side flag 0 in $A12018 and waits for the sub CPU to answer in $A12028, then clears it.
